Name: Crystalarium Machines Cloner(1.6optimezed)
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
[b][size=5]Universal Machine Cloner[/size][/b] ⚙️✨

Why craft when you can clone? This mod upgrades the [b]Crystalarium[/b] to support the production of any machine in the game! No more wasting precious resources on crafting hundreds of kegs.

[b][size=4]Main Features:[/size][/b] 🚀
[list]
[*] [b]Support All Machines:[/b] Whether it's a Keg, Preserves Jar, Bee House, or even Bone Mills—if it's a machine, you can clone it! 🛠️[/*]
[*][b]The 5-Day Rule:[/b] Every high-quality clone requires exactly [b]5 in-game days[/b] to be ready for harvest ⏳.[/*]
[*][b]Infinite Supply:[/b] Once you load a reference machine, it stays inside and produces a new copy every 5 days forever 🔄.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Compatibility:[/b] Fully compatible with automation mods like [i]Automate[/i] for the ultimate farming experience 🤖.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]How to Use:[/size][/b] 💡
[list=1]
[*] Hold the machine you want to copy in your hand.[/*]
[*]Place it into an empty [b]Crystalarium[/b].[/*]
[*]Wait for [b]5 full days[/b], then collect your brand new machine! 🎁[/*]
[/list]
[i]Note: This mod is designed to keep your game balanced while saving you the headache of mass-crafting.[/i]
